description: The page URL on the site redirects to a page on ANOTHER origin, which is then processed.

thin.note: Page redirects must stay on the allowed host (ALLOWED_HOSTNAME): a redirect to another host fails the job. NOTE: in these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port, so a hostname-only policy would FOLLOW this redirect; the test must treat host:port as the identity for this case, or inject the policy. redirect-page-off-host-alias-hostname is the same rule with a different hostname.
